items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk wants to merge SpaceX and Tesla into a $3.4 trillion giant. The problem: it would lose money from day one
items.summary_cn: 分析指出马斯克想合并SpaceX与特斯拉，但该交易从第一天起就会亏损，对特斯拉构成利空。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Saw the Domino’s App and Couldn’t Believe Tesla Needed 64 Clicks to Sell a Car
items.summary_cn: Musk 批评特斯拉购车流程繁琐（需64次点击），暗示公司运营效率问题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: The Odds SpaceX Merges With Tesla Are Higher Than You Think
items.summary_cn: 分析认为SpaceX与特斯拉合并的可能性高于预期，涉及特斯拉与航天板块。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Trump Shovels $4 Billion Directly to Elon Musk, Who Spent a Fortune Getting Him Elected
items.summary_cn: 新闻称特朗普政府向马斯克旗下公司（如SpaceX）提供巨额资金，涉及政府合同与航天板块。
